help.howto: Click the map to add a waypoint. Each leg is the fastest walk on the {res_m} m grid for {scenario}; the dashed line is the way home from the last waypoint.
help.sources: Leg times and leg O₂ are computed in your browser with the engine's walking model ({crew}, {variants}) on the {res_m} m grid with {elevation_res_m} m terrain heights ({elevation_file}), so they can differ from the engine's {route_res_m} m routes. Time home and O₂ home come from the engine's fields ({fields}). O₂ capacity: primary supply per {o2_source} (computed from its formula); reserve: {reserve_min} min at the effort cap; EVA limit: {eva_h} h. Planned time at a waypoint is station work at the station task rate ({crew_file} {rate_key}, {rate} L/min); tags and notes are labels only.
